title: Constant closed-ball density ratio at z forces x − z ∈ T_x a.e. for a stationary varifold
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, n) with μ = R.measure = θ·H^n⌞M, and z ∈ ℝ^P. Assume v(M, θ) is stationary in ℝ^P: R.firstVariation X = 0 for every C¹ vector field X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support. Assume also μ(B̄_ρ(z)) = ρ^n μ(B̄_1(z)) for every ρ > 0 (closed balls, ρ^n read as ENNReal.ofReal(ρ^n)). Then for μ-a.e. x, p_x(x − z) = x − z, where p_x is the orthogonal projection onto T_x = approxTangentPlane n M x; i.e. x − z ∈ T_x for μ-a.e. x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (z : Euclid P), (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0) → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → R.measure (closedBall z ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall z 1)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - z) = x - z
